items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: I made some records of him once.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a bass player.

Yeah, he was a bass player. That's Bill. That's Bill. Bill Johnson, Louse. Oh, well what did Dink Johnson, was he a poet on a train? No, he played drums some and also played a little bit of piano. He played clarinet once with Ory. He learned to play clarinet in eight years ago. Bill Johnson, I never did know that guy. I knew him. I made some records of him once. He was dead now. But he was a younger brother of Bill Johnson. That plays right to the ballpark over there. Called Dink's Flicks right there at the…
Well, I think that's about all the questions that I've been asked about.
